# Pre-draw stochastic-conditioning amendment — r0.5

Status: normative closure amendment

All U1 mean, reference-variance, reference-covariance, and operational-
covariance statements condition only on
'h_pre = (g_resolved, theta)'.

The pre-draw condition fixes parent/class, template, 'D_loc'/extraction,
weight state, support/missingness semantics, subspace/rank/null,
regularization, numerical profile, 'P_C', response-query domain, and failure
semantics. Attempt, realized, publication, outcome, success/failure, and
observed-value facts are provenance after the draw. They are not permitted
conditioning variables. Success conditioning, censoring, pairwise deletion,
or a draw-dependent domain defines a separately named population and role.
